chapter: New York, Philadelphia and Harlem nightlife
title: The first big jazz festival with Tatum and Bechet
summary: He stages a concert with Art Tatum, Sidney Bechet, Baby Dodds and Mezzrow that loses him money.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Then I decided that I'd have a big concert. That's when I had Art Tatum and Sidney Bechet. I say that that was the first jazz festival ever held, you know what I mean, in America by a black. And I don't remember anybody else ever having held one before 1947, do you? And then I had Art Tatum, Sidney Bechet, Baby Dodds and Milton Mezzrow and, you know, a lot of people like that. Big, you know what I mean, big flock. Cost me over a thousand dollars, which I had to pay out. Art had promised me that he'd play and if I lost money he'd give me some of the money back. But Joe Marsala, his manager, vetoed that.
